help.writeNote: A person on the team reads every email.

help.q1: How do I change my reminder time?
help.a1: Open Profile, then Settings, then Daily reminder. Pick a new time or turn it off.
help.a2: Tap the lock. It lists what opens the unit, like a skill check to pass.
help.q3: I think my answer was right. What can I do?
help.a3: On the step, tap “Ask for a review” and say why. A person replies here and in your notifications.
help.q4: How do I cancel my subscription?
help.a4: In Settings, then Plan and billing. Pro stays on until the end of the period you paid for.
help.q5: How do I delete my account?
help.a5: Settings, then Delete my account. Personal data is removed within 30 days.
